disorder-name.supporting_text: "SCZ-Test-U, BD-Test-U, and ADHD-Test-U are the sets of psychiatric patients consisting of 47 SCZ patients, 45 BD patients, and 39 ADHD patients from the UCLA dataset, respectively. dataset-of-origin.detail: SCZ patients drawn from two public datasets: UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study (SCZ-Test-U, n=47) and Center for Biomedical Research Excellence COBRE (SCZ-Test-C, n=49).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study (UCLA) public dataset was selected to train and test the normative model since it contains healthy individuals and ADHD, BD, and SCZ patients. The Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE) public dataset, which is composed of healthy individuals and SCZ patients, was also chosen to evaluate the performance of the trained model on an independent dataset."

age.detail: SCZ-Test-U (UCLA, n=47): range 22–49, mean 37. SCZ-Test-C (COBRE, n=49): range 19–50, mean 31. Combined range: 19–50. Weighted mean: (47×37 + 49×31) / 96 = 3258 / 96 ≈ 33.94. SD not reported.
